mechanism_survival.rationale: A coherent source-derived chain remains: discrete draft units undergo handling events; separate, evidence-tagged ledgers record and inspect transitions; continuity and contradictions supply signals; these support the explicitly retained inference, "Where the compositional ledger is continuous for a unit, this supports the proposed sequence of drafting, revision and placement for that unit." This remains conditional on recording reliability and the stated weakness of retrospective trace reconstruction. Deletion removes arrangement authentication and a best-sequence selection rule, but does not destroy this unit-level mechanism.

surviving_contributions: Bounded support for unit-level revision histories survives in "Where the compositional ledger is continuous for a unit, this supports the proposed sequence of drafting, revision and placement for that unit." It does not establish a whole composition history.

Uncertainty remains explicitly localized through "Claims are graded by the ledger: supported by contemporaneous record; supported by reconstruction from trace; or unsupported across a break" and "A break weakens only the claims that depend on that transition."

Alternative assembly sequences remain an explicit output: "Mark every unexplained transition as a break and draft each assembly sequence compatible with the ledger" and "at each break the competing assembly sequences are retained rather than reduced to one."

Material next inquiries and a bounded stopping rule survive: "Follow-up for each open break: collate further witnesses, request accession and conservation files, consult dated correspondence, and re-inspect the material features at that point"; stop when transitions are classified and "the accessible witnesses and records have been consulted."

The separation of compositional and later handling survives in "Keep the two phases in separate ledgers," together with the constraint that "Present order and narrative order are not treated as composition order unless the ledger independently links them."
